name: Sexika de Shengi
source: After a bloody war, the heroine fell asleep for 300 years and just woke up in the present day... However she lost her memory and has now to deal with a new life with new friends, but also she will have to pursue the truth behind the war that killed her family. Can she be a normal school student while chasing the secrets of a long-forgotten war?
translation: 血腥战争结束后，女主角沉睡了300年，刚刚在现代醒来……然而她失去了记忆，不得不与新朋友共同适应新生活，同时追查那场夺走家人生命的战争真相。她能一边追逐被遗忘已久的战争秘密，一边当一名普通的学生吗？
